ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate ratio of 8.5:1.5 high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Vast central white contiguous zone; low-intensity black pixels localized as a continuous band along the trailing edge (5-15 pixel width), a dense cluster at the median notch, and irregular framing of distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated internal pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude varies from 2 to 18 pixels; maximum frequency of peaks occurs on the distal third of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Sigmoidal trajectory; initial convexity at the median notch transitioning to a shallow concavity along the central trailing edge boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of a cluster of approximately 8-12 dark circular pixel aggregates (3-10 pixel diameter) in the lower-right lobe quadrant; scattered individual spots on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal dark linear disruption on the left lobe (~45 pixels length); one shorter horizontal mark on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular fringe-like tissue modifications/serrations at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, diverging from typical smooth leading-to-trailing edge transitions.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a singular, high-contrast dark focal spot located in the upper-medial region of the right lobe surface.
